TC-20/S13.title: Switching care setting, deep links and reload: each dashboard lists only its own patient
TC-20/S13.detail: PW, local stack 25acd727, model mocked or blocked at the socket (tripwire clean). Judged 20/20. Hospital -> Nursing Home -> Hospital through the list toggle and each list's Dashboard control, then /snf/dashboard + reload and /rounding/dashboard + reload: each of the 5 checkpoints lists only its own patient, Total 1, no stuck loading or 'being updated', and the resident with no unit shows '0 tasks pending' (no 'undefined' / 'null' / 'NaN').
